extracted.intended_audience: merchants, traders, and accounting clerks performing barter/valuation calculations (historical Italian merchant context)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and rules for valuing goods and determining fair exchanges in barter transactions (converting goods to monetary units, setting discounts/allowances, computing gains/losses and apportions). Includes worked examples with wool, cloth, spices, coin units and repeated barters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert goods to a common monetary unit before comparing
rubrics_metrics.description: "mettere a cotati / contanti" — convertire la lana, il panno, ecc. nel medesimo valore monetario (cótati / contanti) prima di confrontare o barattare.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every barter example first translates each good into 'cótati' or 'contanti' (money-equivalents). The text repeatedly instructs to value the 'canna', 'pezza' or unit of wool/cloth in contanti so that comparisons and abaratto calculations can be made (e.g., "baratta lana e panno la canna a cotanti vai ..." and then compute abaratto).

rubrics_metrics.name: Set an 'abaratto' (allowance/discount) to equalize differing values
rubrics_metrics.description: Use an 'abaratto' (discount/allowance) on one side to make the monetary values equal: "abaratto fi còto / abaratto fi conto".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When one good's cash value differs from another, reduce (abaratto) one side by the computed amount so totals match. The manual gives many worked numeric examples showing how to pick the abaratto so that, e.g., wool and cloth exchanged become of equal contanti value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute per-unit value and scale to exchanged quantities
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine the value per unit (e.g., per canna, per pezzo, per cento) and multiply by exchanged quantities to find total values for the barter: "valef a contanti... la canna... la pezza".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The text demonstrates computing per-canna or per-pezzo prices (e.g., 'la canna del panno a cotanti...'; '100 cotati' etc.) and then scaling those unit values to the actual quantities traded to determine gains/losses and required abatements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjust for quality/condition differences when valuing goods
rubrics_metrics.description: If goods differ in quality (buoni / modiﬁcano boni / vari condizioni), adjust their monetary valuation accordingly before exchange.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The manual advises accounting for differing quality or condition (references to 'boni', 'modificano boni', 'molte bai facto', 'valuta di giég?') and shows altering the unit valuation and abaratto to reflect inferior/superior quality so the barter is fair.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handle multi-item barters by valuing each item and summing
rubrics_metrics.description: When bartering several different goods (e.g., lana, panno, pepe, garofano), compute each item's contanti value and sum them to compare to the counterparty's total: 'baratta lana e panno ... pepe ... garofe'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show multi-item exchanges where each commodity is priced and then aggregated; the abaratto and any money portion are set against the aggregate sum to balance the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: When money (contanti) is requested in addition to goods, compute the required fraction/part of capital
rubrics_metrics.description: If one party demands a cash portion or a fraction (e.g., 'il terzo', 'una parte', 'vno terzo'), calculate that fraction of the capital and include it in the barter computations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text repeatedly treats cases like 'se vuol d' dentroqs piglia el terzo di... ' — instructs computing the third/part of capital and adjusting the barter so that the requested cash plus goods equal fair value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calculate gains and losses as percentages of capital and apportion them
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the gain (guadagno) or loss (perdette) resulting from the barter as a percentage of each party's capital and use those percentages to reconcile unequal outcomes: 'calcolare guadagno ... percento ... parte del capitale'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The manual explains how to express gains/losses relative to capital (e.g., 'guadagno de 7ì contco od mio capitale'), combine gains and losses across parties and use proportional arithmetic to determine how much of capital is affected and how to settle differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: For repeated barters, accumulate gains/losses and recompute proportions
rubrics_metrics.description: When the same parties barters repeatedly, aggregate prior gains and losses and recompute fair shares across time: 'per lo baratto piu volte ... adire vol dar ... altre tati ... accumulare'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show multi-period accounting: after repeated exchanges track accumulated profit/loss and apportion future exchanges accordingly (e.g., 'i guadagni infiemi faranno ...', 'ragione che parte io guadagno ... e tu perdi ...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply currency/conversion rates and coinage units correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: When values involve different coin units (ducati, etc.) or different monetary standards, convert using the proper rates before comparing: 'duc ... Duc.bologna ... contare el cento ... convertire in lira / ducati'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The text includes conversions among coin units (e.g., ducati examples) and instructs converting to a single monetary basis (contanti/cótati) and considering margins and exchange differences when computing abaratto and final settlements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test fairness by sample exchange and adjust the abaratto if the sample favors one side
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform a hypothetical small-quantity exchange to see which side gains and then adjust the abaratto or ask for cash to make the exchange equitable: 'poni dx quello da la lana guadagnaffe vno esimo ... prova con un numero ... vedi che parte...'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several worked examples use small test quantities (e.g., one canna, 100 cotati) to check whether the proposed barter yields gain to one party; if so, increase/decrease the abaratto or include cash to correct the imbalance.

rubrics_metrics.name: When values are unequal, compute corrective shares via proportions/denominators ('la virga' method)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use proportional/arithmetic devices ('la virga', denominators, parts) to split and reconcile unequal gains and losses and determine required transfers: 'la virga fa una cosa ... partir pur uno per quello ... per la perdita ... uno decimo ...'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The text gives a procedural method (describing forming ratios/lines and partitioning into denominators) to transform unequal results into divisible parts so that gains and losses can be offset and the final settlement computed.
